name: Companah Pet Cremation & Aftercare
notes: Women-owned family business; water cremation; 3 NC locations (Apex, Greensboro, Sanford). Site has a 'For Veterinarians' section and a memorial shop (urns, keepsake jewelry, paw print impressions). Pitch: memorial portrait as an aftercare add-on. Contact verified on homepage 2026-10-14.

name: Peaceful Paws Pet Cremations
notes: Family-run, Western NC. Sells urns, jewelry, hand-blown glass paw prints. No public email (contact form only). Call first.

name: Charm City Pet Crematory
notes: Personalized urns, engraved nameplates, clay paw prints, fur keepsakes; picks up from vet offices. Second line (443) 567-3192. Email on site is spam-protected: copy it from the site by hand.

name: Forever Faithful Pet Cremation
notes: Family-owned per site. Private cremation includes a wooden urn and clay paw print; has an urns & keepsakes page; picks up from any vet clinic. No public email.

name: Faithful Companion Pet Cremation
notes: Multi-state network run by the Santeiu family: 14 offices (GA, IN, NC, OH, SC, TX, FL, TN, MI), each with its own inbox (e.g. cleveland@, tncontact@, dallas@). Exclusive cremation provider for many vets. One yes can cover many markets: ask for whoever owns memorial products. Emails from /contact-us.

name: Family Pet Crematory Inc.
notes: Works only with a select group of vet hospitals. Offers clay paw prints, fur clippings, keepsake urns. Good test of the vet-channel card.

name: Central Florida Pet Crematory
notes: Since 2003 per site; founder's family are vets at Belleview Veterinary Hospital. Private and witnessed cremation; pickup from homes and vets. Email from contact page.

name: Loving Paws Pet Loss Center
notes: Cremation and aquamation. Memorial package already includes ink paw prints and a celebration video, so portraits fit. Has a vet/owner login portal.

name: Pet Meadow
notes: 'Family founded. Family led.' 13 locations in CT, FL, GA, MD, NJ, NC, TX, VA. Sells memorial products and keepsakes. Email is spam-protected on /contact. Network-level pitch. The phone number is the site's 'Call now' link.

name: Final Gift Pet Memorial Center (Northborough)
notes: One of 13 Final Gift locations in 8 Northeast states. Careers and privacy pages point to Gateway Services, so it is likely part of a larger group. Start local, then ask for the regional memorial-products lead.

name: Paws at Peace
notes: In-home euthanasia, hospice and private cremation; euthanasia includes a clay pawprint and fur keepsake. Vet-led, so apply the memorial ethics rules strictly. Email is spam-protected on site.

name: Cline & Hanson Funeral Home (pet cremation)
notes: Funeral home with private pet cremation (says it is one of NE Wisconsin's only private pet cremation facilities). Paw-print urn included; sells memorial jewelry. Also Borchardt & Moder locations.

name: Starkson Family Funeral Homes / River Valley Pet Cremation Society
notes: Family-owned funeral home with a sister pet cremation brand (River Valley Pet Cremation Society, (651) 318-4020). Offers keepsake ornaments and reflection stones.

name: Lap of Love Veterinary Hospice & In-Home Euthanasia
notes: National network of in-home euthanasia and hospice vets. Runs pet-loss support resources and a memorial keepsakes page. Network-level partnership: no public partnerships email, so use the main line or LinkedIn. Highest sensitivity.

name: Loyal Companion Pet Cremation
notes: Parting Stone partner since 2022 per Parting Stone's partner finder (find.partingstone.com), so it already sells premium memorial products. Address 43 Amy Way. Website blocked automated reading; get the email from the site by hand.

name: Muttville Senior Dog Rescue
notes: Senior dog rescue. Adoption portraits plus 'Seniors for Seniors'. Also events@muttville.org. Senior dogs = a gentle 'portrait while they are here' angle (no urgency).

name: Lucky Dog Animal Rescue
notes: DC-area foster network plus a SC rescue campus ((843) 920-6557). Contact form only; no public email.

name: PawSafe Animal Rescue
notes: Already a target in marketing/channels/shelter-partnership.md (@psar_rachael). CT shelter plus a NY foster network ((845) 293-0920).

name: Old Dog Haven
notes: Senior dog sanctuary and foster network. development@olddoghaven.org handles corporate sponsorship. Offers grief and end-of-life counseling, so memorial work needs care.

name: Lost Our Home Pet Rescue
notes: Address 2323 S Hardy Dr. Contact page shows help@ (its mailto link uses info@); the homepage also lists community@lostourhome.org.

name: Homeward Trails Animal Rescue
notes: Serves VA, DC and MD. No phone on the contact page; adoption coordinators are listed in each dog's bio.

name: The Bond Between (formerly Secondhand Hounds)
notes: Rebranded from Secondhand Hounds. Also adoptions@thebondbetween.org. Runs a vet center and a Minneapolis resource center.

name: Lone Star Labrador Retriever Rescue
notes: Lab breed rescue (DFW). Pairs with Lab and golden owner audiences.

name: Golden Retriever Rescue of the Rockies

name: Nittany Beagle Rescue
notes: Foster-based beagle and hound rescue in central PA. Small team: a likely fast yes.

name: Labs and More Rescue
notes: San Diego County rescue. Email is spam-protected on the site (copy it by hand); contact form at /contact-us. No phone listed.

name: Old Friends Senior Dog Sanctuary
notes: Senior dog sanctuary with a 'Forever Foster' network. Address 765 Nonaville Rd. Senior and memorial angle; handle gently.

name: Hearts & Bones Rescue

name: Rescue Dogs Rock NYC

name: Motley Zoo Animal Rescue
notes: Foster-based rescue (Redmond and Monroe WA). Also events@motleyzoo.org.

name: Rocket Dog Rescue
